name: pd-intel-code
description: Claude Code mod for exploring PD Intelligence data and building reports from it, made for non-technical users: /pd opens a panel with your datasets and the chosen one's numbers at a glance (press a dataset to work in it, one-press Explore and Write a report), the chosen dataset shows in the status line and Claude uses it without asking, an evidence ledger lists every PD Intelligence call for a report's sources (optionally saving raw results as JSON for charts), and destructive writes always ask
